supported_model_backends.purpose: offline default, tests and certification fixtures; not a language model

supported_model_backends.kind: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API on a loopback address
supported_model_backends.network_boundary: loopback addresses only; non-loopback URLs are refused before any request; environment proxies are bypassed

supported_model_backends.gating: requires MUCARO_AI_LIVE_MODE=1, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and allow_live=true per request; never selected implicitly

supported_hardware_baseline.notes: Model weights are not bundled. Storage for weights depends on the model the user installs in their local server (for example about 5 GB for an 8B model at 4-bit quantization).

offline_capabilities: See `mucaro offline manifest` / GET /offline-manifest: ingestion, retrieval, cited answers (mock or local model), GIS, memory and exports work offline; web tools and the remote model require a network.
known_limitations: Mucaro does not ship or download model weights; a local model server must be installed and running for openai_compatible_local.
No claim of universal local-model compatibility: only the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions protocol subset above is exercised by tests.
Answer quality and citation compliance depend on the selected local model; uncited answers are flagged ERROR_UNCITED_ANSWER rather than accepted.
Models do not call tools; tool actions are explicit user commands through the approval gate.
Text-only modality; image/audio modalities route as MODALITY_UNSUPPORTED.
Remote-provider behaviour is verified with gating tests only; live remote evaluation is blocked on credentials (BLK-LLM-001).
